subject: Science
title: Class 9 Science Olympiad — Paper 3
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: If '+' means 'x', 'x' means '-', '-' means '÷', evaluate: 6 + 2 x 3
Complete the analogy: Thermometer is to Temperature as Barometer is to ____
A is the son of B. B is the sister of C. How is A related to C?
Find the missing number: 2, 5, 10, 17, __
Find the odd one out: Frog, Fish, Whale, Crocodile
If 6 workers finish a job in 10 days, how many days will 15 workers take?
Five students are ranked by height. Amit is taller than Bina but shorter than Chetan. Deepa is the tallest. Who is the shortest possible given only this info?
options: Cannot be determined without more data, but Bina is shorter than Amit

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 20, 40, __
If in a code, PLANT is written as QMBOU, how is WATER written?
Statement: All fish live in water. A shark is a fish. Conclusion: A shark lives in water.
An object moving with uniform velocity has what kind of acceleration?
Which of Newton's laws explains why a passenger jerks forward when a bus suddenly stops?
What do we call the number of protons in an atom's nucleus?
Which method is used to increase crop yield by growing two or more crops on the same field simultaneously?
What is the term for animals raised for milk, meat, or other products?
Sound cannot travel through which of these?
Which gas makes up approximately 78% of Earth's atmosphere?
What is the SI unit of power?
Which simple machine is a see-saw an example of?
What is the term for the loss of soil due to wind or water?
Which process changes a solid directly into a gas without becoming liquid?
What is the SI unit of force?
Which of these best describes a colloid?
options: A pure substance with fixed composition
A mixture where particles settle quickly
A mixture where components are completely separated
A mixture where particles are larger than in a solution but do not settle, e.g., milk

questions.question: According to Newton's third law, for every action there is a reaction that is:
options: Equal in magnitude and same direction
Equal in magnitude and opposite in direction

questions.question: Who proposed the plum pudding model of the atom?
Which type of change is 'melting of wax' — physical or chemical?
What is the audible range of frequency for the human ear?
Which process describes water moving from a dilute to a concentrated solution through a semi-permeable membrane?
Which particle in an atom was discovered by Rutherford's gold foil experiment to be concentrated in the nucleus?
Which form of energy is possessed by a stretched rubber band?
Which organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
What happens to the pressure exerted by a liquid as depth increases?
What is the SI unit of work?
Which type of tissue allows movement in animals?
What is the valency of oxygen?
Which vitamin is produced in the skin upon exposure to sunlight?
Which kingdom includes organisms like mushrooms and yeast?

Which force is responsible for objects floating or sinking in a liquid?

Which of these is a homogeneous mixture?
A student pushes a heavy box but it does not move despite applying force. Explain using Newton's laws why no work is done in the physics sense.
options: Work is done because force was applied
Work is zero because there is no displacement, even though force is applied

questions.question: Comparing crop rotation with monoculture farming, what long-term advantage does crop rotation offer for soil health?
options: It eliminates the need for fertilizers entirely
It helps replenish soil nutrients and reduces pest/disease buildup by varying crops
It has no measurable impact on soil quality
It always produces higher yields in a single season

questions.question: If the number of neutrons in an atom is changed while the number of protons stays the same, what results?
options: An isotope of the same element is formed
A different element with the same atomic number

questions.question: A student mixes iron filings with sulphur powder and heats the mixture, forming iron sulphide. How can we tell this is a chemical change rather than physical mixing?
options: A new substance (iron sulphide) forms with different properties, and the change is not easily reversible by physical means
No new substance forms, only the color changes
The iron filings can still be separated with a magnet after heating
It is reversible by simply cooling the mixture

questions.question: A plant's root hair cells absorb water from soil that has a lower solute concentration than the cell sap. Which process explains this water uptake?
options: Osmosis, as water moves from a region of higher water potential (soil) to lower water potential (cell)
Diffusion of solutes into the soil
Transpiration pulling water directly into roots
